title: Diane Powell takes on John Mack's legacy and a synchronous Oregon house

tellings.quote: he dies he gets hit by a car very tragically in London and she goes to his memorial and I guess all the people at the memorial are like uh Dr Powell you have to take on uh Dr John Max's Legacy

plain: In 2004 John Mack, a psychiatrist who studied people who said they had met aliens, was hit by a car and killed in London, and at his memorial the people gathered there told the psychiatrist Diane Powell that she had to take on his legacy. Michels tells this himself, passing on Powell's own story, and the episode ties it to an Oregon house where things lined up in meaningful ways for her, though he gives no detail of that. He tells it to explain how Powell came to carry on Mack's kind of research.
